hero.tagline: For men who want their whole life to work, not just their income
hero.headline: Get Your Whole Life Working. Not Just Your Income.

about.heading: I help men who've built real success in some areas find harmony across all of them — career and money included, not at the expense of anything else.
about.sub: Not by grinding until you break. By designing a life worth protecting and a business or career that  supports it.

items.text: You can learn Google Ads from a chatbot. You can find Amazon strategies in a free YouTube video. Every marketing tactic you need is already out there, indexed and searchable. So why are you still stuck?

Because information without perspective is noise. You don't need another course that teaches you what to do. You need someone who has already done it, consistently, and can show you what it actually looks like on the other side.

I'm not selling a secret formula. I'm offering something you can't Google: the lived experience of building a business that pays well, runs from anywhere, and still leaves room for the things that matter.

mystory.heading: From Chasing Income to Building a Life That Works

timeline.label: The Beginning
timeline.text: I started by promoting services online through social media. Instagram, Facebook, YouTube. I learned what worked by doing it, not by reading about it.

timeline.label: The Pivot
timeline.text: When COVID hit, I pivoted hard into e-commerce. While most people were scrambling, I found opportunity selling products on Amazon and through Google Ads. That season was devastating for a lot of people. For me, it became one of the most abundant and fruitful stretches of my career because I had the online skills to adapt.

timeline.label: The Agency
timeline.text: Those skills opened doors. Business owners started asking for help. Freelance consulting turned into a full marketing agency offering Google Ads management, Amazon listing optimization, and conversion strategy.

timeline.label: The Growth
timeline.text: About three years in, I expanded into local service businesses. Community members who needed help getting visible when foot traffic disappeared. When stimulus money started flowing, my clients were positioned to capture it. That's how the agency found its footing and has grown ever since.

mystory.bannerBody: Through all of it, one thing stayed constant: I built this business to support my life, not replace it. The business was never the point. The life it made possible was. And now I help others do the same.

foryou.heading: This Is For You If...

items.text: Things are working in a lot of areas of your life, but not all of them, and you can feel the gap
You've chased success and hit some of it, and it still doesn't feel like enough
You're done consuming content that never adds up to a real change
Location independence matters to you. You want to work from Pittsburgh, Phoenix, Maui or anywhere in between
You care about your health, your relationships, and your quality of life as much as your income
You like to learn from people you actually resonate with, not just someone who made money.

foryou.contrastText: This isn't a get-rich quick gamble and it isn't a course. It's an experience-driven guidance for men who want a life that works in every area, not just on paper.

lifestyleaudit.heading: Get Clarity Before You Commit
lifestyleaudit.subtext: Not sure where to start? Both of these give you honest, direct feedback on where your life actually stands. And where you want it to be. Start free, go deeper when you're ready.

products.title: The Quality of Life Quiz
products.description: A guided quiz that walks you through the eight areas of the Life Wheel: health, relationships, career, finances, personal growth, fun, environment, and contribution. You'll get an honest breakdown of what's aligned, what's off, and where to focus first.

products.title: Quality of Life Reset
products.description: A one-on-one hour with Ryan. We go deep on where you are across every area, find what's really holding you back, and build a plan to bring your life back into harmony.

features.text: Full review of your career or business goals and quality of life
Custom roadmap delivered after the call

steps.title: We Talk
steps.text: Book a call. Tell me where you are, where you want to go, and what's getting in the way. No pitch. Just a real conversation about whether we're a good fit.

steps.title: We Map It Out
steps.text: I build a plan around your specific situation. Your skills, your goals, your lifestyle. Not a template. A path that makes sense for the business and the life you want to create.

steps.title: We Build It Together
steps.text: You execute with my guidance, perspective, and accountability behind you. I've walked this road. I know where the potholes are. And I'll tell you what I wish someone had told me years ago.

philosophy.heading: Start With the Life. Reverse Engineer the Business.
philosophy.col1p1: Most people start with tactics. Pick a niche. Run ads. Scale. They build the machine first and hope the life comes later. It usually doesn't.
philosophy.col1p2: Start with the big, intangible idea. The life you actually want to live. Where you want to wake up. Who you want next to you. How you want your days to feel. That's the starting point.
philosophy.col2p1: Then we bring it down into something concrete. A business model that supports it. Daily habits that sustain it. Relationships that grow alongside it. From the abstract to the tangible. From the vision to the reality.
philosophy.col2p2: That's not motivational talk. That's how I built my own life. And it's the framework behind everything I teach.

finalcta.heading: Ready to Build a Life Worth Protecting?
finalcta.body: If you're tired of consuming and ready to start building, let's talk. One conversation is all it takes to know if this is the right path for you.
